groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Access Control Requirements
NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Audit and Accountability (AU) Requirements

controls.title: System audit logs must be created and retained (minimum 90 days) to support monitoring and investigation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System audit logs must be created and retained (minimum 90 days) to support monitoring and investigation

controls.title: Individual user actions must be uniquely traceable; shared accounts must be prohibited

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Individual user actions must be uniquely traceable; shared accounts must be prohibited

controls.title: Logged events must be defined, periodically reviewed, and updated as needed

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Logged events must be defined, periodically reviewed, and updated as needed

controls.title: Alerts must be configured for audit logging process failures and responsible personnel must be notified

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Alerts must be configured for audit logging process failures and responsible personnel must be notified

controls.title: Audit records must be correlated across systems to support investigation of suspicious activity

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit records must be correlated across systems to support investigation of suspicious activity

controls.title: Audit record reduction and report generation capability must be available for on-demand analysis

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit record reduction and report generation capability must be available for on-demand analysis

controls.title: All system clocks must be synchronized with an authoritative NTP source for accurate audit timestamps

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: All system clocks must be synchronized with an authoritative NTP source for accurate audit timestamps

controls.title: Audit information and tools must be protected from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit information and tools must be protected from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion

controls.title: Management of audit logging must be restricted to a subset of privileged users with documented access list

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Management of audit logging must be restricted to a subset of privileged users with documented access list

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Awareness and Training (AT) Requirements

controls.title: A security awareness program covering CUI-related risks must be established for all personnel

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A security awareness program covering CUI-related risks must be established for all personnel

controls.title: Role-based security training must be provided before granting access and tracked to completion

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Role-based security training must be provided before granting access and tracked to completion

controls.title: Security awareness training must cover phishing, social engineering, insider threats, and reporting procedures

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security awareness training must cover phishing, social engineering, insider threats, and reporting procedures

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Configuration Management (CM) Requirements

controls.title: Baseline configurations and system inventories must be established, documented, and maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Baseline configurations and system inventories must be established, documented, and maintained

controls.title: Security configuration settings must be established and enforced for all IT products

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security configuration settings must be established and enforced for all IT products

controls.title: Changes to organizational systems must be tracked, reviewed, approved, and logged

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Changes to organizational systems must be tracked, reviewed, approved, and logged

controls.title: Security impact analysis must be performed and documented before implementing system changes

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security impact analysis must be performed and documented before implementing system changes

controls.title: Physical and logical access restrictions for system changes must be defined, approved, and enforced

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Physical and logical access restrictions for system changes must be defined, approved, and enforced

controls.title: Systems must be configured for least functionality with unnecessary functions disabled and reviewed periodically

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Systems must be configured for least functionality with unnecessary functions disabled and reviewed periodically

controls.title: Nonessential programs, ports, protocols, and services must be restricted, disabled, or prevented

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Nonessential programs, ports, protocols, and services must be restricted, disabled, or prevented

controls.title: A deny-by-exception policy must be implemented with an authorized software list and automated enforcement

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A deny-by-exception policy must be implemented with an authorized software list and automated enforcement

controls.title: User-installed software must be controlled with installation restrictions and active monitoring

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: User-installed software must be controlled with installation restrictions and active monitoring

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Identification and Authentication (IA) Requirements

controls.title: All system users, processes, and devices must be uniquely identified

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: All system users, processes, and devices must be uniquely identified

controls.title: Identity must be authenticated before granting access to organizational systems at all entry points

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identity must be authenticated before granting access to organizational systems at all entry points

controls.title: MFA must be used for local and network access to privileged accounts and network access to non-privileged accounts

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: MFA must be used for local and network access to privileged accounts and network access to non-privileged accounts

controls.title: Replay-resistant authentication mechanisms must be employed for network access to all account types

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Replay-resistant authentication mechanisms must be employed for network access to all account types

controls.title: Identifiers must be managed with unique IDs and disabled after a maximum of 35 days of inactivity

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identifiers must be managed with unique IDs and disabled after a maximum of 35 days of inactivity

controls.title: Identifiers must be automatically disabled after a defined and documented inactivity period

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Identifiers must be automatically disabled after a defined and documented inactivity period

controls.title: Password complexity must be enforced including minimum length of 12 characters and defined change requirements

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Password complexity must be enforced including minimum length of 12 characters and defined change requirements

controls.title: Password reuse must be prohibited for a minimum of 5 previous generations with automated enforcement

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Password reuse must be prohibited for a minimum of 5 previous generations with automated enforcement

controls.title: Temporary passwords must require immediate change upon use and must be securely delivered with expiry enforced

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Temporary passwords must require immediate change upon use and must be securely delivered with expiry enforced

controls.title: Passwords must be cryptographically hashed for storage and encrypted for transmission using approved algorithms

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Passwords must be cryptographically hashed for storage and encrypted for transmission using approved algorithms

controls.title: Authentication feedback (passwords) must be obscured on all interfaces during the authentication process

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Authentication feedback (passwords) must be obscured on all interfaces during the authentication process

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Incident Response (IR) Requirements

controls.title: An operational incident-handling capability must be established covering preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An operational incident-handling capability must be established covering preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response

controls.title: Incidents must be tracked, documented, and reported to designated officials with defined reporting timelines

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incidents must be tracked, documented, and reported to designated officials with defined reporting timelines

controls.title: Incident response capability must be tested at least annually with results reviewed and lessons incorporated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incident response capability must be tested at least annually with results reviewed and lessons incorporated

controls.title: System maintenance must be performed on a documented schedule with records maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System maintenance must be performed on a documented schedule with records maintained

controls.title: Controls must be established for maintenance tools, techniques, mechanisms, and authorized personnel

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Controls must be established for maintenance tools, techniques, mechanisms, and authorized personnel

controls.title: Equipment removed for off-site maintenance must be sanitized of CUI and sanitization must be verified

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Equipment removed for off-site maintenance must be sanitized of CUI and sanitization must be verified

controls.title: Media containing diagnostic programs must be scanned for malicious code before use in maintenance

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Media containing diagnostic programs must be scanned for malicious code before use in maintenance

controls.title: MFA must be required for remote maintenance sessions and connections must be terminated when complete

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: MFA must be required for remote maintenance sessions and connections must be terminated when complete

controls.title: Maintenance personnel without required access authorization must be supervised by authorized individuals

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Maintenance personnel without required access authorization must be supervised by authorized individuals

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Media Protection (MP) Requirements

controls.title: System media containing CUI (paper and digital) must be physically controlled and securely stored

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System media containing CUI (paper and digital) must be physically controlled and securely stored

controls.title: Access to CUI on system media must be limited to authorized users with a documented and enforced access list

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access to CUI on system media must be limited to authorized users with a documented and enforced access list

controls.title: System media must be sanitized using documented methods before disposal or reuse, with verification performed

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System media must be sanitized using documented methods before disposal or reuse, with verification performed

controls.title: Media must be marked with required CUI markings and distribution limitations per documented policy

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Media must be marked with required CUI markings and distribution limitations per documented policy

controls.title: Access to media containing CUI must be controlled during transport with chain-of-custody documentation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access to media containing CUI must be controlled during transport with chain-of-custody documentation

controls.title: Cryptographic mechanisms using approved algorithms must protect CUI confidentiality during transport

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic mechanisms using approved algorithms must protect CUI confidentiality during transport

controls.title: Use of removable media on system components must be controlled with defined policy and technical enforcement

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Use of removable media on system components must be controlled with defined policy and technical enforcement

controls.title: Portable storage devices without identifiable owners must be prohibited with technical enforcement

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Portable storage devices without identifiable owners must be prohibited with technical enforcement

controls.title: Backup CUI must be encrypted and stored in secured locations with restricted access

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Backup CUI must be encrypted and stored in secured locations with restricted access

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Personnel Security (PS) Requirements

controls.title: Personnel screening must be performed prior to authorizing access to systems containing CUI

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Personnel screening must be performed prior to authorizing access to systems containing CUI

controls.title: CUI must be protected during and after personnel actions (terminations, transfers) with timely access revocation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CUI must be protected during and after personnel actions (terminations, transfers) with timely access revocation

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Physical Protection (PE) Requirements

controls.title: Physical access to organizational systems must be limited to authorized individuals with maintained access lists

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Physical access to organizational systems must be limited to authorized individuals with maintained access lists

controls.title: Physical facilities and support infrastructure for organizational systems must be continuously protected and monitored

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Physical facilities and support infrastructure for organizational systems must be continuously protected and monitored

controls.title: Visitors must be escorted and their activity monitored, with visitor logs maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Visitors must be escorted and their activity monitored, with visitor logs maintained

controls.title: Audit logs of physical access must be maintained for all entry points, retained at least 90 days, and reviewed periodically

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit logs of physical access must be maintained for all entry points, retained at least 90 days, and reviewed periodically

controls.title: Physical access devices (keys, cards, PINs) must be inventoried, tracked, with revocation procedures and periodic audits

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Physical access devices (keys, cards, PINs) must be inventoried, tracked, with revocation procedures and periodic audits

controls.title: Safeguarding measures for CUI must be defined and enforced at alternate work sites including remote work locations

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Safeguarding measures for CUI must be defined and enforced at alternate work sites including remote work locations

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Risk Assessment (RA) Requirements

controls.title: Risk assessments must be performed at least annually covering operations, assets, individuals, and CUI handling

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Risk assessments must be performed at least annually covering operations, assets, individuals, and CUI handling

controls.title: Vulnerability scans must be performed periodically and triggered when new vulnerabilities affecting systems are identified

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Vulnerability scans must be performed periodically and triggered when new vulnerabilities affecting systems are identified

controls.title: Vulnerabilities must be remediated per risk assessment priority: critical within 15 days, high within 30 days

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Vulnerabilities must be remediated per risk assessment priority: critical within 15 days, high within 30 days

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - Security Assessment (CA) Requirements

controls.title: Security controls must be periodically assessed by an independent assessor to determine effectiveness

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security controls must be periodically assessed by an independent assessor to determine effectiveness

controls.title: Plans of action (POA&M) must be developed and implemented to correct deficiencies with tracked milestones

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Plans of action (POA&M) must be developed and implemented to correct deficiencies with tracked milestones

controls.title: Security controls must be continuously monitored on an ongoing basis with automated mechanisms where possible

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security controls must be continuously monitored on an ongoing basis with automated mechanisms where possible

controls.title: System security plans must be documented, describing boundaries, environments, implementation, and interconnections, and updated periodically

parts.prose: System security plans must be documented, describing boundaries, environments, implementation, and interconnections, and updated periodically

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - System and Communications Protection (SC) Requirements

controls.title: Communications must be monitored, controlled, and protected at external boundaries and key internal boundaries

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Communications must be monitored, controlled, and protected at external boundaries and key internal boundaries

controls.title: Security engineering principles including security by design and secure SDLC must be employed and documented

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security engineering principles including security by design and secure SDLC must be employed and documented

controls.title: User functionality must be technically separated from system management functionality with distinct admin interfaces

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: User functionality must be technically separated from system management functionality with distinct admin interfaces

controls.title: Unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources must be prevented through resource isolation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources must be prevented through resource isolation

controls.title: Publicly accessible system components must be in subnetworks physically or logically separated from internal networks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Publicly accessible system components must be in subnetworks physically or logically separated from internal networks

controls.title: Network communications must default to deny-all with permit-by-exception; all exceptions must be documented

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Network communications must default to deny-all with permit-by-exception; all exceptions must be documented

controls.title: Split tunneling must be prevented to stop remote devices from simultaneously accessing organizational and external networks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Split tunneling must be prevented to stop remote devices from simultaneously accessing organizational and external networks

controls.title: FIPS-approved cryptographic mechanisms must protect CUI confidentiality during all transmission

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FIPS-approved cryptographic mechanisms must protect CUI confidentiality during all transmission

controls.title: Network connections must be automatically terminated after a defined period of inactivity across all connection types

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Network connections must be automatically terminated after a defined period of inactivity across all connection types

controls.title: Cryptographic keys must be managed with documented generation, secured distribution, rotation policy, and destruction procedures

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic keys must be managed with documented generation, secured distribution, rotation policy, and destruction procedures

controls.title: FIPS-validated cryptographic modules must be employed for protecting CUI with an inventory maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: FIPS-validated cryptographic modules must be employed for protecting CUI with an inventory maintained

controls.title: Remote activation of collaborative computing devices must be prohibited with presence indicators for users

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Remote activation of collaborative computing devices must be prohibited with presence indicators for users

controls.title: Mobile code use must be controlled with defined policy, technical controls, and active monitoring

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Mobile code use must be controlled with defined policy, technical controls, and active monitoring

controls.title: VoIP technology use must be controlled with defined policy, technical controls, and active monitoring

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: VoIP technology use must be controlled with defined policy, technical controls, and active monitoring

controls.title: The authenticity of communications sessions must be protected with session authentication and replay protection

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The authenticity of communications sessions must be protected with session authentication and replay protection

controls.title: CUI at rest must be protected with FIPS-approved encryption across all CUI storage locations

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CUI at rest must be protected with FIPS-approved encryption across all CUI storage locations

groups.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 - System and Information Integrity (SI) Requirements

controls.title: System flaws must be identified, reported, and corrected in a timely manner with a tracking system

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System flaws must be identified, reported, and corrected in a timely manner with a tracking system

controls.title: Malicious code protection must be deployed at entry/exit points, workstations, and servers using approved solutions

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Malicious code protection must be deployed at entry/exit points, workstations, and servers using approved solutions

controls.title: Security alerts and advisories must be monitored with subscriptions to threat feeds and defined response procedures

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security alerts and advisories must be monitored with subscriptions to threat feeds and defined response procedures

controls.title: Malicious code protection mechanisms must be automatically updated on a defined schedule for all systems

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Malicious code protection mechanisms must be automatically updated on a defined schedule for all systems

controls.title: Periodic system scans and real-time scanning of files from external sources must be performed per defined schedule

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Periodic system scans and real-time scanning of files from external sources must be performed per defined schedule

controls.title: Systems and inbound/outbound communications traffic must be monitored to detect attacks and indicators of compromise

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Systems and inbound/outbound communications traffic must be monitored to detect attacks and indicators of compromise
